content.user_title: Research Topics Across Web, Docs, and Code
content.value_statement: Research tasks often need current sources, local documentation, and code examples. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through parallel research with confidence-based synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Selects quick, standard, or extensive mode based on required depth and time.
Coordinates web, documentation, and code researchers in parallel.
Defines concise, balanced, and comprehensive research report formats.
Assigns confidence levels based on source agreement.
Highlights conflicting information and incomplete source coverage.
Supports current web research, local documentation lookup, and codebase examples.
limitations: Web research requires network access and may hit rate limits.
Quick mode can miss nuance because it uses fewer sources.
Extensive mode can take up to 10 minutes and use more model calls.
The skill cannot access paywalled or private sources without available tools.

use_cases.title: Verify a Time-Sensitive Fact
use_cases.description: Use quick mode to check a simple claim against web and documentation sources.

use_cases.title: Research an Implementation Pattern
use_cases.description: Use standard mode to compare web guidance, local docs, and codebase examples.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Technical Decision Brief
use_cases.description: Use extensive mode to gather competing perspectives and summarize tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Fact Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this in quick mode: What is the current purpose of TOON format? Include confidence and sources.

prompt_templates.title: Standard Technical Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this in standard mode: How should we implement WebSocket authentication? Compare web guidance, docs, and code examples.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Tools
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a balanced comparison.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this in standard mode: Compare Codex CLI and Claude Code workflows for agentic development. Include tradeoffs and source confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Deep Decision Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this in extensive mode: Choose an observability approach for AI agent runs. Include alternatives, conflicts, risks, and recommendations.

output_examples.input: Research TOON format in quick mode.
output_examples.output: A short answer with web and documentation sources, followed by a HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW confidence label.

output_examples.input: Research WebSocket authentication in standard mode.
output_examples.output: A research report with a summary, key findings, implementation notes, sources, and agent coverage metadata.

output_examples.input: Research a major architecture choice in extensive mode.
output_examples.output: A comprehensive report with executive summary, comparative analysis, recommendations, conflicts, further research, and source groups.

best_practices: Use quick mode only for narrow questions that need short answers.
Use standard mode when implementation details or local code examples matter.
Use extensive mode for decisions that require source diversity and conflict review.
anti_patterns: Do not use quick mode for broad architecture decisions.
Do not treat single-source findings as final without manual review.
Do not run extensive mode when the extra latency and cost are not justified.

faq.question: What does this skill research?
faq.answer: It researches user questions across web results, local documentation, and code examples when those sources are available.

faq.question: Which mode should I choose first?
faq.answer: Choose quick for simple facts, standard for most technical questions, and extensive for complex decisions.

faq.question: Does it provide confidence levels?
faq.answer: Yes. It labels findings as high, medium, low, or conflicting based on source agreement.

faq.question: Can it search a codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. The code researcher looks for implementation examples, tests, configuration, and local documentation.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Only web research requires internet access. Documentation and code research can use local files.

faq.question: Is extensive mode always better?
faq.answer: No. Extensive mode costs more time and model calls, so use it only when depth is needed.
